name: Kettlebell Sumo Squat
description: With your feet wide and toes turned out, hold a kettlebell hanging between your legs and squat down, knees out over your toes, then stand back up.

source.title: Physitrack: Kettlebell sumo squat
source.note: Described in our own words. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Feet wider than your shoulders, toes turned out.
Hold the bell by the handle in both hands, arms long.
cues: Push the floor away to stand.

prescription.note: Move slowly: about 2 seconds to lift or push and 2 seconds to lower. Start with a light bell.

keyframes.name: Stand wide
keyframes.cue: Feet wide, toes turned out, the bell hanging in both hands.

keyframes.name: Squat
keyframes.cue: Bend your knees out over your toes and lower, chest up.
